entities.name: Ferdinand Magellan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Portuguese explorer (1480–1521) who organized the first circumnavigation of the Earth under the Spanish flag. Though killed in the Philippines in 1521, his expedition — completed by Juan Sebastián Elcano — proved the Earth's sphericity and revealed the vast Pacific Ocean.
